intro: Hana'zua is a Darkspear troll scout stationed in the Valley of Trials who fell victim to the poisonous beasts prowling the canyon ridges. Stricken and wounded by the monstrous scorpid Sarkoth, he lies awaiting assistance from young Horde initiates seeking to prove their valor.

p: While traversing the arid heights overlooking the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua encountered Sarkoth, an exceptionally vicious and venomous scorpid that stalks the cliffs. Overwhelmed and stung by the beast, the troll barely survived the confrontation. Unable to move or return to camp on his own, he languishes amid the dust, counting on passing recruits to finish the creature and deliver word of his plight back to the Den.
